title: ReSeTOX: Re-learning attention weights for toxicity mitigation in machine translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the amount of added toxicity and the percentage of toxicity mitigation across sentences containing female, male, and neutral nouns using the HOLISTICBIAS dataset.

Comparing the performance of the toxicity mitigation method (added toxicity reduction and translation quality) across 164 languages, specifically analyzing the performance disparities between high-resource and low-resource languages.
